content.title: Women's Awareness Defense & Empowerment (W.A.D.E)
content.summary: The Women's Awareness Defense & Empowerment (W.A.D.E) course offers free self-defense training and awareness skills for women, taught by police officers. This 8-hour course is available to Arvada residents and those working in the area, welcoming participants aged 18 and older (14+ with a parent). Currently, all classes are full, but a waitlist for future sessions is available.
content.body:
The Women's Awareness Defense & Empowerment (W.A.D.E) course is a free class taught by police officers, designed to provide women with fundamental awareness skills and self-defense techniques to aid in the management and prevention of assaults and encounters.

This 8-hour course is held throughout the year and is available to Arvada residents or those working in Arvada. It includes a lecture and hands-on training as well as an opportunity to practice your new skills! Ages 18+ are welcome to apply (14+ with a parent attending).

## Contact & Registration

For additional questions and information, contact Commander Jason Ammon at [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#563c373b3b39381637242037323778392431) or (720) 898-6846. Future dates for this class have not yet been determined.

All classes are full at this time. We have opened a waitlist for future classes. If you would like to be added, please [fill out the waitlist form](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/37803).
